title: Xenarchy
description: Light-weight modpack for the Xenarchy anarchy server.
body:
![Xenarchy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c4f057508dea9db10792e90c6d25454843133ba_0.webp)
---

**This modpack is purely for performance, cosmetics, and voice chat.**

A lightweight Fabric client modpack focused on performance, stability, and simple quality-of-life improvements. It boosts FPS, reduces memory usage, and adds features like dynamic lighting and voice chat.

The modpack will continue to be updated with carefully selected performance and QoL improvements, while remaining lightweight and not altering gameplay.

If you encounter any issues or bugs, please report it on the GitHub or Discord. Additionally, you can also send an email to admin@xenarchy.net.
